method: Pool post-first tokens/time. Median of per-response steady round medians; exclude first eight post-first rounds from that median. Startup, warmup, cold prefill, HTTP, Pi, tools and snapshots excluded. Lightweight dispatch counters remain active. Natural trajectories may differ; token rate also depends on tokens accepted per round.
scope: Brief compiled-engine performance controls; no new correctness qualification. The native RoPE rounding intervention affects eager execution and is not timed here.
